subject: Discovery follow-up: FastRetail steering panel & procurement next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@fastretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: FastRetail steering panel & procurement next steps

Hi Elena (and team),

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — great context on the retail use cases and your Q4 roadmap. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a steering committee on the calendar: 

Recap (high-level)
- Primary goal: personalization at scale for omnichannel catalog (40-60ms target p95 for inference on customer queries).
- Economic buyer: Rajiv Patel (CPO) — wants measurable uplift in conversion and a clear cost/performance story.
- Security: Sam Jenkins (VP Legal) will own security+compliance questions; procurement is Priya.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Please confirm the attendee list for a 60- to 90-minute steering committee (economic buyer + security + procurement + product).
2) Procurement: can you share a rough timeline for your legal/procurement gates and any required docs (PO, SOW cadence)?
3) Decision criteria: if you have a short list of success metrics for the pilot or rollout, please send them (e.g., latency SLO, cost per 1k queries, precision@k).

We attached a short discovery notes export and a proposed steering agenda to accelerate scheduling. If helpful, Rishi can build a 15–20 minute technical demo highlighting our latency/quantization tradeoffs for the panel.

Proposed steering windows (all PDT):
- Tue 13 Oct, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 14 Oct, 14:00–15:30
- Thu 15 Oct, 09:00–10:30

Elena — can you confirm availability or suggest alternatives?

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

[Attachment: proposed-steering-outline.docx (DOCX, 64KB)]

Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@fastretail.com>, Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@fastretail.com>, Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@fastretail.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:24:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: FastRetail steering panel & procurement next steps

Ben — thanks for the clear notes. Confirming a few items from our side: 

Stakeholders to invite (confirmed):
- Rajiv Patel — EVP Product (economic buyer)
- Sam Jenkins — VP Legal & Security
- Priya Gupta — Head of Procurement
- Lina Ortega — Director, Data Science (technical sponsor)
- Me (Elena) — Product owner / program manager

Procurement/legal timeline
- Internal procurement kickoff: 10/11
- Initial SOW + commercial review: target week of 10/18
- Legal redlines expected: 2–3 business days after SOW delivery

Decision criteria (prioritized)
1) Production latency p95 <= 70ms at pilot scale
2) Observable uplift in recommendations CTR within 8 weeks
3) Clear TCO estimate for steady-state at 10M monthly queries

Availability: the 14 Oct slot (Wed 14 Oct, 14:00–15:30 PDT) works best for Rajiv and Sam. Priya can join the 14th if we keep it to 90 minutes.

Attaching a simple decision-criteria workbook and our procurement contact details.

Elena

--
Elena Morales
Head of Product, Personalization | FastRetail
elena.morales@fastretail.com

Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: FastRetail steering panel & procurement next steps

Thanks Elena — good to have the confirmed attendee list and the 14 Oct window. Internal ask: Laura/Rishi/Monica, can you review the attached steering outline and the decision criteria Elena shared and flag any gaps? Specifically:

- Rishi: can you add a short demo plan that shows p95 vs. qps at both hosted and dedicated deployments (15 min demo + 10 min Q&A).
- Monica: please prepare a one-slide summary of our support/observability commitments and escalation flow for procurement/legal to review.
- Laura: I may need sign-off to propose a pilot commercial construct (60-day pilot, three-tier SLA) — if acceptable, I’ll include a pilot credit offer to reduce friction.

I attached a first-pass steering deck (v1) that we can iterate on before 10/14. I’ll send a calendar invite once we confirm attendance.

Thanks — aiming to keep the panel focused and outcome-driven.

Ben

--

Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Ben / team — quick technical notes for the steering deck and the demo: 

Demo plan (15–20 min)
- 5 min: architecture and routing (hosted vs. dedicated)
- 7 min: live perf demo showing p95 at different batching configs (we'll use a replay of their query distribution)
- 3 min: fallbacks & cost control (quantization options + routing policies)

Tech prerequisites for a productive session
- Short sample of production query distribution (one day aggregate) or representative prompt set
- Clarify allowed data residency (we'll need to know if any data must remain in a VPC)

Attached: SOC2 summary and a link to our internal SRE runbook for inference incidents. I can tailor the runbook excerpt for Sam if the security team wants it pre-review.

Rishi

Thanks — this is moving in the right direction. A couple of asks before I give greenlight to commercial terms: 

1) Ben: draft a short pilot commercial (60 days, usage cap, SLA tiers) and include suggested pilot credits. I want the pilot to have a clean exit decision (metrics-based).
2) Legal: Ben, please copy in our legal lead if there are any non-standard contract items likely to come up. We should aim to deliver SOW to FastRetail week of 10/18 as Elena suggested.
3) Customer success: Monica, prepare a one-page onboarding plan (kickoff, metrics collection, weekly checkpoints).

If folks are aligned on the deck, go ahead and lock the 14 Oct slot and send calendar invites to all confirmed attendees.

Laura
